shortDefinition: The field focused on ensuring AI systems behave reliably and beneficially.
fullDefinition: AI safety is an interdisciplinary field focused on ensuring that AI systems are reliable, transparent, aligned with human values, and free from harmful behaviors. At a practical level it includes red-teaming models for dangerous outputs, building alignment techniques (RLHF), testing for bias, and creating guardrails. At a strategic level it includes research into preventing catastrophic risks from increasingly powerful AI systems.
